problems.explain: The length is w + 1. A perimeter goes round all four sides, two widths and two lengths: 2w + 2(w + 1) = 10. w(w + 1) would be its area.

problems.explain: The length is w + 6. A perimeter goes round all four sides, two widths and two lengths: 2w + 2(w + 6) = 48. w(w + 6) would be its area.
